entities.convention: The stored segment is a start point and an end point.
entities.note: Groups 10 and 11 are the segment ends (Autodesk DXF Reference, LINE).

entities.convention: Each vertex bulge applies to the segment that starts there, and the closing segment uses the last vertex bulge.
entities.note: Group 42 is tan of one quarter of the included angle and is positive to the left of the chord (Autodesk DXF Reference, LWPOLYLINE).

entities.convention: Start and end angles are degrees counterclockwise from the OCS x-axis.
traps: OCS and extrusion via the arbitrary-axis algorithm
stored angles in degrees CCW, with $ANGDIR/$ANGBASE display-only
entities.note: Groups 50 and 51 stay counterclockwise degrees even when the header display direction changes (Autodesk DXF Reference, ARC).

entities.convention: The circle is a center and a radius in the OCS.
entities.note: Group 40 is the radius (Autodesk DXF Reference, CIRCLE).

entities.convention: Start and end are parameters about the major axis, not degree angles.
entities.note: Groups 41 and 42 are parametric angles about the major axis (Autodesk DXF Reference, ELLIPSE).

entities.convention: A clamped unit-weight degree 2 or 3 spline is Bezier and every other clamped spline is BSpline.
entities.note: Group 70 bits mark closed, periodic, and rational splines (Autodesk DXF Reference, SPLINE).

entities.convention: A similarity insert expands its block and unequal x and y scales decline.
traps: INSERT scale, rotation and column/row arrays
entities.note: Groups 41 and 42 are scales, group 50 is rotation, and groups 70 and 71 are the column and row counts (Autodesk DXF Reference, INSERT).

entities.convention: Vertices are following VERTEX entities, not inline bulge pairs.
entities.note: An R12 POLYLINE is followed by VERTEX entities until SEQEND (Autodesk DXF Reference, POLYLINE).

entities.convention: The entity is text, not a curve.
entities.note: Group 1 is the text string (Autodesk DXF Reference, TEXT).

entities.convention: The entity is multiline text, not a curve.
entities.note: Groups 1 and 3 hold the text (Autodesk DXF Reference, MTEXT).

entities.convention: The entity is an attribute value, not a curve.
entities.note: Group 1 is the attribute value (Autodesk DXF Reference, ATTRIB).

entities.convention: The entity is an attribute definition, not a curve.
entities.note: Group 2 is the attribute tag (Autodesk DXF Reference, ATTDEF).

entities.convention: The entity is text drawn along an arc, not the arc itself.
entities.note: Group 1 is the arc-aligned text string (Autodesk DXF Reference, ARCALIGNEDTEXT).

entities.convention: The entity is a dimension, not a curve.
entities.note: Group 1 is the dimension text (Autodesk DXF Reference, DIMENSION).

entities.convention: The entity is a leader, not a curve.
entities.note: Group 10 repeats the leader vertices (Autodesk DXF Reference, LEADER).

entities.convention: The entity is a multileader, not a curve.
entities.note: Group 300 carries the multileader context (Autodesk DXF Reference, MULTILEADER).

entities.convention: MLEADER is the same multileader entity under its short name.
entities.note: The short name uses the same groups as MULTILEADER (Autodesk DXF Reference, MULTILEADER).

entities.convention: The entity is a hatch region, not an outline to emit.
entities.note: Group 91 is the boundary-path count (Autodesk DXF Reference, HATCH).

entities.convention: The entity is a polygon hatch, not an outline to emit.
entities.note: MPOLYGON stores hatch-style boundary paths (Autodesk DXF Reference, MPOLYGON).

entities.convention: The entity is a 3D face.
entities.note: Groups 10 through 13 are the four corners (Autodesk DXF Reference, 3DFACE).

entities.convention: The entity is an ACIS solid.
entities.note: Groups 1 and 3 hold the ACIS data (Autodesk DXF Reference, 3DSOLID).

entities.convention: The entity is an ACIS body.
entities.note: Groups 1 and 3 hold the ACIS body (Autodesk DXF Reference, BODY).

entities.convention: The entity is an ACIS region.
entities.note: Groups 1 and 3 hold the ACIS region (Autodesk DXF Reference, REGION).

entities.convention: The entity is a surface, not a planar curve.
entities.note: SURFACE is declined with the other 3D entities (Autodesk DXF Reference, SURFACE).

entities.convention: The entity is a polygon mesh.
entities.note: Groups 91 and 92 count the mesh vertices and faces (Autodesk DXF Reference, MESH).

entities.convention: The entity is a filled quadrilateral, not a curve.
entities.note: Groups 10 through 13 are the quadrilateral corners (Autodesk DXF Reference, SOLID).

headers.name: $INSUNITS
headers.note: A value of 0 means the drawing is unitless (Autodesk DXF Reference, HEADER).

headers.name: $AUNITS
headers.note: This header selects the displayed angle format (Autodesk DXF Reference, HEADER).

headers.name: $ANGDIR
headers.note: This header selects the displayed angle direction (Autodesk DXF Reference, HEADER).

headers.name: $ANGBASE
headers.note: This header is the displayed angle origin (Autodesk DXF Reference, HEADER).
